text.p: Belgian holding company Almanij NV on Tuesday announced a 10-for-one share split.
It said it had requested the listing of the split shares from August 12.

The share split was approved at an extraordinary general shareholders meeting which also decided to award reduced withholding tax VVPR strips to make its VVPR shares fungible with the ordinary shares.
"Together with the...share split, this measure will favourably influence the liquidity and share price formation of the Almanij shares," the company said.
By awarding the VVPR strips, the VVPR share will become ordinary shares from August 12.
Almanij added that it also requested the separate listing of the VVPR strips on the Brussels bourse from August 12.
The shareholders' meeting decided to award free bonus shares and free VVPR strips at a one-for-50 rate to existing shareholders.
Almanij said it would request the listing of the new shares and new strips resulting from the awarding of the bonus shares and new strips.
